(*#|deploy*)
isothermPlot =
 With[{curves =
    Table[pNormalvdWEquationOfStateNormalized[vNormalized,
      tNormalized], {tNormalized, 0.85, 1.1, 0.025}]},
  Plot[curves, {vNormalized, 0.5, 4}, PlotRange -> {{0, 4}, {0, 2}},
   Frame -> True, PlotStyle -> "ThermometerColors",
   FrameLabel -> {"normalized volume", "normalized pressure"},
   BaseStyle -> 24, ImageSize -> 750,
   PlotLegends ->
    Placed[BarLegend[{"ThermometerColors", {.85, 1.1}},
      LegendLayout -> "Row", LegendLabel -> "normalized temperature",
      LegendFunction -> "Frame", LabelStyle -> 18,
      LegendMarkerSize -> 350], {0.7, 0.85}]]]
